blocking_findings.finding: The parser validates content bytes and the passed document_url but never validates artifact.sha256, artifact.byte_len, artifact.url_requested or artifact.url_final inside the typed dispatch boundary. A mismatched Artifact can therefore receive emitted Evidence even though the content pin passed.
blocking_findings.required_fix: In dispatch, require artifact SHA/byte_len and both URLs to equal the pinned constants before parse; add mismatch tests.

blocking_findings.finding: PageText.truncated is not inspected. Only global truncated and error fields are checked, so a page marked truncated can pass if the caller omits the global flag.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Reject any page with truncated=true in parse/dispatch and add a regression test.
